stories.headline: If a Stock Market Crash Is Coming, History Says These Are the 3 Financial Stocks to Buy
stories.body: Key PointsBerkshire Hathaway has a huge cash hoard, which will soften the hit from a downturn and create buying opportunities.

stories.headline: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z. Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
stories.body: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.

stories.headline: Fed extends deadline for Regulation O comments
stories.body: The central bank extended the deadline for comments on Regulation O by one month, to Nov. 4.
